marketAnalysis.summary:
# Korean Market Analysis (2026-09-29)
**Market Snapshot:**
KOSPI closed at 6,870.81 [b9b1f8b3], while global sentiment remains cautious with VIX at 15.92 [9831ec7c] and Fear&Greed at 33 (fear-dominant) [market-analysis:fear-greed]. US 10Y Treasury yields elevated at 5.264% [79d1c3d8], reflecting persistent rate-hike expectations. The Dollar Index stands at 101.378 [a3917e14], supporting carry-trade headwinds for Korean equities.
**Commodity & Currency Pressure:**
WTI crude at 90.82 USD/barrel [a3d491fe] and gold at 4,193.7 USD/oz [360adf7f] show competing dynamics. According to Reuters and Bloomberg headlines, gold has declined to seven-week lows as Middle East tensions (Hormuz impasse) elevate rate-hike bets, offsetting safe-haven demand—a pattern that pressures yen-carry and emerging markets including Korea.
**Macro Backdrop:**
US CPI remains elevated at 3.4% [2026-08-01 macro.cpi] with Fed Rate at 3.63% [2026-08-01 macro.fed-rate], while NFP adds 162k [2026-08-01 macro.nfp-mom]. This tightening cycle constrains Korean exporters and limits liquidity inflows.
**Reading:** According to WSJ and Kitco reports, the combination of higher yields and a stronger dollar—driven by geopolitical risk premium—may weigh on KOSPI unless risk-off sentiment reverses. *Invalidation check:* Monitor whether Middle East tensions ease, Treasury yields decline, or Korean earnings surprises offset macro headwinds.
